adds.title: The Defenders#1
adds.text: Back in Harlem, Misty takes Luke on a walk and shows him that young people keep dying the same way. When he offers to help, she asks him to steer Cole Miller off that path.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A detective who asks Luke to help keep a Harlem kid alive.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fresh out of prison. Offers to help Misty with the dying Harlem kids.
adds.evidence: The H Word: Misty visits Luke at Claire's, walks with him, shows him Sean Miller and the other similar deaths; Luke offers to help and she sends him to Cole Miller. Later (ep 2) he calls her about the van, (ep 5) asks her help, (ep 7) she interrogates him and agrees to stall the NYPD.

adds.title: The Defenders#2
adds.text: Luke corners Turk at Trouble in a Pair-of-Dice for a lead on White Hat and warns that he will be back if Turk is lying.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A hustler Luke leans on for a lead on White Hat.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Leans on Turk for a lead on White Hat.
adds.evidence: Mean Right Hook: at Trouble in a Pair-of-Dice, Cage confronts Turk Barrett about White Hat; Turk describes him as wearing white, and Cage threatens to return if he is lying.

adds.title: The Defenders#8
adds.text: After Midland Circle falls, Foggy meets Claire and Luke as their lawyer. When Foggy blames himself for bringing Matt the suit, Claire tells him nobody could have talked Matt out of it.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Matt's friend. Tells Foggy nobody could have stopped Matt.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Claire's lawyer after Midland Circle. Blames himself for giving Matt the suit.
adds.evidence: The Defenders (episode): a few days later Nelson meets with Temple and Cage as their lawyer; Nelson blames himself for bringing Murdock the suit and Temple insists there would have been no talking Murdock out of it.
